notes: truncation_detected=true refers to two ceilings that were caught and worked around, not to a truncated deliverable. (1) A single combined PubMed affiliation query returned exactly count=1000, so it was split into 22 per-term queries whose counts all equalled their retrieved id counts; union = 1057 unique PMIDs, no ceiling. (2) McLeod's Algolia index reports nbHits=805 but nbPages=1 at hitsPerPage=100 (paginationLimitedTo), so a blind browse would have silently returned 100/805; specialty-scoped queries were used instead and the live_specialties index was read to enumerate the specialty vocabulary. All three round-1 corrections were reproduced clamped: efetch db=pmc served 4/4 PMCIDs and returned both known-good addresses; full-forename disambiguation discarded 48 affiliation-locked-but-wrong-person matches including the documented Dveet-vs-Deeran Patel case; OpenAlex 429'd on its single attempt. The correction that moved the most was #4 - both rung-3 patterns were reproduced without a browser (Grand Strand physicianData in __NEXT_DATA__ via sitemap-discovered profile URLs; McLeod's Algolia app id + public search-only key shipped in page HTML as var crbAlgoliaCredentials). Round 1B's department-phone falsification holds for Conway/Tidelands/Grand Strand facility pages but is wrong for provider-directory records: McLeod and Grand Strand both publish the anesthesia group's own line inside their directory payloads, which is where 12 department numbers came from. Email ceiling confirmed at exactly 3 - the same 3 people round 1 open reached with 11 sources; 69 of 72 still have no affiliation-locked publication.
